rationale: Both Grady and Peter are building at the intersection of AI-powered wearables and clinical health applications—Grady through RAMHT's rapid-acting mental health platform and his FDA-cleared NightWare device, Peter through Azumio's deep learning models for cardiac monitoring and diabetes detection. Grady's 15+ years navigating FDA regulatory pathways and commercializing into VA/DoD markets could directly inform Peter's clinical-grade wearable AI ambitions, while Peter's 18+ years of embedded systems and mobile health expertise spans the technical execution layer Grady's conviction-driven approach to digital therapeutics requires.
intro_message: Grady Hannah, meet Peter Kuhar — you're both pioneering AI-guided wearables for clinical health, and your complementary expertise in FDA regulation (Grady) and embedded AI systems (Peter) could unlock new possibilities for scaling digital therapeutics.
